title: "IPUMS County Data Preparation"

## 1. Setup

This notebook prepares county-level socioeconomic
variables from IPUMS NHGIS county level data  for use in
roadway lane-mile statistical estimation.

Source: IPUMS USA

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(ipumsr)

# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()

# Define IPUMS input 

NHGIS_dir <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$nhgis$data_dir
)



stopifnot(dir.exists(NHGIS_dir))
```

## 2. Load IPUMS HSGIS data and filter to states we want

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)



csv_files <- list.files(
  path = NHGIS_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

csv_files

NHGIS_2010 <-read.csv(csv_files[[1]]) ## contains employment industry occupation for 2010

NHGIS_2020 <- read.csv(csv_files[[2]]) ## contains employment industry occupation for 2020  

NHGIS_1980 <- read.csv(csv_files[[3]]) ##  contains employment industry occupation numbers for 1980

NHGIS_1990 <- read.csv(csv_files[[4]]) ## contains employment industry occupation (used) and vehicles per Hispanic HH (not used)

NHGIS_2000  <-read.csv(csv_files[[5]]) ## contains industry by sex will need to combine

NHGIS_TS <- read.csv(csv_files[[6]])  ## time series contains most of the variables

## now filter

selected_states <- c(6, 41, 53, 4, 49, 32, 16, 35)

NHGIS_1980 <- NHGIS_1980 %>%
  filter(STATEA %in% selected_states)

NHGIS_1990 <- NHGIS_1990 %>%
  filter(STATEA %in% selected_states)

NHGIS_2000 <- NHGIS_2000 %>%
  filter(STATEA %in% selected_states)

NHGIS_2010 <- NHGIS_2010 %>%
  mutate(FIPS = substr(Geography, nchar(Geography) - 4, nchar(Geography)), ## pulls FIPS out of geography
         STATEA = as.integer(substr(FIPS, 1, 2)),
         COUNTYA = as.integer(substr(FIPS, 3,5)),
         FIPS = as.integer(FIPS)) %>% 
  filter(STATEA %in% selected_states)

NHGIS_2020 <- NHGIS_2020 %>%
  mutate(FIPS = substr(Geography, nchar(Geography) - 4, nchar(Geography)), ## pulls FIPS out of geography
         STATEA = as.integer(substr(FIPS, 1, 2)),
         COUNTYA = as.integer(substr(FIPS, 3,5)),
         FIPS = as.integer(FIPS)) %>% 
  filter(STATEA %in% selected_states)
 
 NHGIS_TS <- NHGIS_TS %>%
   filter(STATEFP %in% selected_states) %>%
   rename(STATEA =STATEFP,
          COUNTYA = COUNTYFP)%>%
   mutate(FIPS= STATEA*1000+COUNTYA)



```

## 3. Reformatting TS dataset 
```{r}
## some of the years variables are ranges as they come from the 5 year ACS 
## these need to be aligned with the years they represent. However some data did
## come from the 2010 and 2020 census and have those years.  Thereofre I need to 
## make 2 new DF, one for ACS data, one for 2010 and 2020 census data, join those
## then re append them to the 1980-2000 data

##Further the YEAR variable is now a character and will need to be converted to 
## an int for when it is merged with both other NHGIS data and with the HPMS data

# first recover the distinct years 
years <- NHGIS_TS %>% 
  distinct(YEAR)
years

## now make dataset of ACS data, Census data, and trim off these data from the TS
## also turn the years into an integer 

ACS_2010_2020 <- NHGIS_TS %>% 
  filter(YEAR=="2011-2015" | YEAR=="2020-2024") %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  mutate(YEAR=case_when(YEAR=="2011-2015" ~ "2010",
                   YEAR=="2020-2024" ~ "2020",
                   TRUE ~ YEAR),
         YEAR=as.integer(YEAR))

DEC_2010_2020 <-NHGIS_TS %>%
  filter(YEAR=="2010" | YEAR=="2020") %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  mutate(YEAR=as.integer(YEAR))

NHGIS_TS <- NHGIS_TS %>% 
  filter(YEAR=="1980" | YEAR=="1990" | YEAR=="2000") %>%
  mutate(YEAR=as.integer(YEAR))
  

## now join the 2010-2020 datasets



NHGIS_2010_2020 <- DEC_2010_2020 %>%
  left_join(
    ACS_2010_2020 %>%
      select(
        FIPS,
        YEAR,
        all_of(setdiff(names(ACS_2010_2020), names(DEC_2010_2020)))
      ),
    by = c("FIPS", "YEAR")
  )

 

## and re append the last 2 decades to the bottom 

NHGIS_TS <- bind_rows(NHGIS_TS, NHGIS_2010_2020)

## drop the temporary data sets
#rm(NHGIS_2010_2020, ACS_2010_2020, DEC_2010_2020)


stopifnot(is.integer(NHGIS_TS$YEAR))

 

```
## 4. Create new variables and select down to columns to merge on

```{r}
## There are two consistently non time series columns, industry and vehicles
## for each county we want the share of manufacturing in LF  
## each year handles these data a little differently, we need to adjust.

## 1980 
# Sum all employment, sum manufacturing, divide manufacturing by all employment

NHGIS_1980_merge <- NHGIS_1980 %>%
  mutate(emp_total = rowSums(select(., starts_with("ind_")), na.rm = TRUE),
         emp_mfg = rowSums(select(., starts_with("ind_mfg")),na.rm = TRUE), 
        share_man= emp_mfg/emp_total,
        FIPS = STATEA*1000+COUNTYA) %>%
  select(YEAR, share_man, emp_total, emp_mfg, FIPS)

## 1990
# Sum all employment, sum manufacturing, divide manufacturing by all employment

NHGIS_1990_merge <-NHGIS_1990 %>%
  mutate(emp_total = rowSums(select(., starts_with("ind_")), na.rm = TRUE),
         emp_mfg = rowSums(select(., starts_with("ind_mfg")),na.rm = TRUE), 
        share_man= emp_mfg/emp_total, 
        FIPS = STATEA*1000+COUNTYA) %>%
  select(YEAR, share_man, emp_total, emp_mfg, FIPS)


## 2000 
# Sum all employment, sum manufacturing, divide manufacturing by all employment
# this year is split by gender so we will also need to make sure to include both


NHGIS_2000_merge <-NHGIS_2000 %>%
  mutate(emp_total = rowSums(select(., starts_with("ind_")), na.rm = TRUE),
         emp_mfg = rowSums(select(., ends_with("manufacturing")),na.rm = TRUE), 
        share_man= emp_mfg/emp_total,
        FIPS = STATEA*1000+COUNTYA) %>%
  select(YEAR, share_man, emp_total, emp_mfg, FIPS)


## 2010
# emp_total already exists, just need to divide

NHGIS_2010_merge <-NHGIS_2010 %>%
  rename(emp_total = Total..Estimate..Civilian.employed.population.16.years.and.over,
         emp_mfg = Total..Estimate..Manufacturing) %>%
  mutate(share_man= emp_mfg/emp_total,
        YEAR = 2010 ) %>%
  select(FIPS, share_man, emp_mfg, emp_total, YEAR)

 

## 2020

NHGIS_2020_merge <-NHGIS_2020 %>%
  rename(emp_total = Estimate..Total..Civilian.employed.population.16.years.and.over,
         emp_mfg = Estimate..Total..Civilian.employed.population.16.years.and.over..Manufacturing) %>%
  mutate(share_man= emp_mfg/emp_total,
        FIPS = substr(Geography, nchar(Geography) - 4, nchar(Geography)), ## pulls FIPS out of geography
        FIPS = as.integer(FIPS),
        YEAR = 2020) %>%
  select(FIPS, share_man, emp_mfg, emp_total, YEAR)

#bind them all together

Emp_TS <- bind_rows(NHGIS_1980_merge, NHGIS_1990_merge, NHGIS_2000_merge, NHGIS_2010_merge, NHGIS_2020_merge)


```



## 5. Combine the CSV into one  

```{r}

NHGIS_Data <- NHGIS_TS %>%
  left_join(Emp_TS, by = c("FIPS", "YEAR")) %>%
  rename(year = YEAR)


 

```

## 6. Export County-Level IPUMS Dataset

Save the processed dataset to the configured output
directory and verify the exported file.

```{r export-ipums}
# Create output directory if it does not exist
dir.create(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Construct output file path
output_file <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$nhgis$output_file
)

# Write CSV
write.csv(
  NHGIS_Data,
  output_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Dataset saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Read the CSV back for verification
exported_data <- read.csv(output_file)

# Verify dimensions and column names
stopifnot(
  nrow(exported_data) == nrow(NHGIS_Data),
  identical(names(exported_data), names(NHGIS_Data))
)

cat("Export verification passed.\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(exported_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(exported_data), "\n")

#clean up the memory
rm(list = ls())

```
